name: PQC Readiness Policy
description: Enforce post-quantum cryptography readiness. Blocks deprecated and quantum-vulnerable algorithms.

notes.RSA: Vulnerable to quantum attacks (Shor's algorithm). Plan migration to ML-KEM/ML-DSA.
notes.DSA: Vulnerable to quantum attacks. Plan migration to ML-DSA.
notes.ECDSA: Vulnerable to quantum attacks. Plan migration to ML-DSA.
notes.SHA1PRNG: Legacy PRNG. Consider migrating to DRBG-based alternatives.
